spanish: el candelabro el puro, sus lámparas, lámparas del arreglo, y todos sus utensilios y el aceite de la lumbrera,

findings.issue: Second «el» makes puro look like its own determined noun; the token is an attributive adjective of the lampstand.

notes: Lamps repeated, 3fs suffixes, totality, oil, and luminary stay within the tokens.
